propositions: A ticket directory with no CREATE or SNAPSHOT event causes the plan-relation reducer to fail with reducer-error, surfacing as INDETERMINATE verdict on unrelated tickets in the same relation graph.

Empty ticket directories created by incomplete writes are invisible to git (cannot be tracked), persist until manual removal, and do not appear in git status, making them undetectable in shared history or branches.
The plan-review reducer walks the store directory listing and fails when encountering an empty directory, whereas prior fixes only addressed git-visible artifacts through .gitignore.
The failure signal incorrectly names the broken orphan ticket rather than the ticket being reviewed, creating wrong-direction debugging signals.

The plan-relation reducer must tolerate and skip event-less ticket directories with a warning, while the write path keeps creating directories before their first event to avoid writer-side race conditions under concurrent multi-session store access.
